# Tea with Ree

> A space to pause and reflect. Words wander through ecology, inner work,
> wellbeing and the tools shaping our time.

Written by Rehana Rutti. Cape Town, South Africa.
Where reflection meets curiosity.

## Sections

- [Ecology](https://teawithree.com/ecology.html): rescue, rewilding and the quiet lives around us
- [Inner Work](https://teawithree.com/inner-work.html): confidence, stillness and the discipline of noticing
- [Wellbeing](https://teawithree.com/wellbeing.html): the body as a landscape, not a machine
- [Modern Tools](https://teawithree.com/tools.html): technology that serves thought, not the other way round
- [Tea Notes](https://teawithree.com/tea-notes.html): private coaching conversations, shaped around Reset, Renewal and Becoming
- [About](https://teawithree.com/about.html): Rehana Rutti

## Notes for anyone quoting this site

All writing is by Rehana Rutti. Please attribute to Tea with Ree and link to
the page you are quoting. The site carries no dates by choice: the writing is
not news and is not meant to be read as a timeline.
